name: Card complete burst
description: A small burst of sparks and a ring popping from a point on a card's edge when a task is done, sized for a list item rather than a whole screen.

name: Agent working border
description: A calm beam of colour gliding round a region's border while an agent works on it, one hue per agent when several work at once.

name: Change pulse
description: A one-shot highlight on an element that just changed: a ring that blooms out from a new one, a sweep across an edited one, a flash that closes in on a removed one.

name: Denoise reveal
description: A picture resolving out of noise the way a diffusion model makes it: coarse blotches of colour settle into shapes, then detail, as the grain clears.

name: Goo drop reveal
description: A flat, ink-stroked blob drops in, splats across the frame and wipes away to the side, leaving its slot revealed with a word in it.

name: Generating field
description: A soft field brewing over a card while a job runs, its motion set by what is being made, with a glowing front that sweeps across as the job gets further along.

controls.l: Motion (0 image, 1 video, 2 audio, 3 text, 4 vector)

value.description: How far along the job is, 0–1; null (or left out) while it cannot tell, so the loader plays its own loop.

name: Slop vat
description: A stroked machine vat filling with bubbling slop to how far a job has got, gooey lobes bobbing on the surface and a nozzle dripping into a puddle below.

value.description: How far along the job is, 0–1; null (or left out) while it cannot tell, so the loader plays its own loop.

name: Memphis burst
description: Memphis pop-art shapes spring out from the centre with hard shadows: four-point sparkles, a squiggle, a ring, a triangle and dots, then settle and fade. A flat alternative to confetti.

name: Dragover attract
description: A dashed drop zone whose border bulges toward the pointer while something is dragged over it, and ripples out from where the item lands.

name: Daydream
description: A picture seen as a remembered or imagined scene: its highlights bleed into a softly breathing glow, thin luminous wisps drift across it, its edges dissolve into haze and a faint shimmer plays over it, while its shapes and colours still read, even as a small thumbnail.

controls.l: Dissolving edges (share of the short side)

name: Petal fall
description: Falling cherry blossom and rose petals drifting on a breeze with a swaying 3D flip, soft depth blur and click bursts.

name: Money rain
description: Spinning metallic coins with moving glints and fluttering banknotes raining down, piling at the bottom and bursting wherever you click.

name: Pixerate paint
description: A glossy, bristle-streaked neon paint stroke along the pointer's path, two-toned and twisting, solid at its head and breaking apart towards its tail into glowing square pixels that scatter, drift and twinkle.

name: Swash text
description: A title with a glossy gradient ribbon swashing through it: in under the letters along the baseline, a loop over them, then an arc hooking over the end, rounded and twisting, shedding star sparkles, then eroding into frost.

name: Ribbon curl
description: A translucent gradient swash woven through what changed: a thin tail runs under the letters, loops over them and swells into an arc that hooks over the end of the word, shedding sparkles, then dissolves into frost. It is drawn only once the edit has landed; while the word is typed there is just a tint.

name: Design frame
description: A design tool's selection: a thin box with square corner handles tracing round what is checked and selected, and the box lingering round what changed before it fades.

name: Presence
description: A collaborator's presence, as in a shared document: a caret with a coloured name tag, an outline pulsing round what is being checked, and a selection and change tint in the collaborator's colour.

name: Scan line
description: A bright scanning line with a fading trail passing over the words being checked, a scanned selection, and a final pass over what changed.

name: Shimmer
description: A loading skeleton: the words sit on rounded pills while a bright glint streaks across them twice as they are checked, a pill selection, and a last glint across what changed.

name: Glow underline
description: A glowing underline sweeping on beneath the words being checked and wiping away from its tail, a lit underline under the selection, and a glowing caret.
